title: Acceptance of Patient Payment Plan Terms
content:
**Patient Payment Plans — Agreement terms: acceptance**

**A. Personal acceptance.** A plan takes effect only when the patient personally accepts its terms through one of the ways of acceptance the term allows. An agent can offer a plan but cannot accept it for the patient. Acceptance is the patient's own act.

**B. Acceptance window.** Acceptance must happen no later than the term's acceptance window, in calendar days, after the plan was offered. The acceptance window counts calendar days with the offer date as day 0, and acceptance on the last day is on time. The offer date is the date the plan was offered, as the plan record shows it.

**C. Down payment.** Any down payment is paid at acceptance.

**D. Effect of acceptance.** On acceptance the enrolled invoices move onto the plan and their statements stop; the plan becomes active. The written agreement follows within the term's agreement period in business days.

**E. Lapse.** An offer not accepted by the end of the window lapses, the plan is closed as cancelled, and its invoices stay in the statement cycle.

## Counting the window — boundary cases

Hypothetical offer made on 1 June, under a 10-day window:

| Date of acceptance | Day count (1 June is day 0) | On time |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 0 | Yes |
| 11 June | 10 — the last day | Yes |
| 12 June | 11 | No; the offer has lapsed |

Under a 14-day window the same offer could be accepted up to and including 15 June.

## Outcomes at a glance

| What happens within the window | Result |
|---|---|
| The patient personally accepts through an allowed way | The plan becomes active; any down payment is paid; invoices move onto the plan and their statements stop; the written agreement follows |
| An agent states acceptance on the patient's behalf | Not an acceptance; the plan does not take effect |
| Nothing by the end of the last day | The offer lapses; the invoices stay in the statement cycle |

## Basis Q&A

**Can someone other than the patient accept the plan for the patient?** No. The terms take effect only on the patient's own acceptance through an allowed way.

**Does acceptance on the tenth day after a 10-day offer count?** Yes. Day 10 is the last day of the window and acceptance on it is on time.
